<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
before = current_frame
res = action([{'action': 'MOUSE', 'row': 33, 'col': 61}])
print("result:", {k: last_action_result[k] for k in ('board_changed','level_completed','done','reward')})
b = before.ascii.split('\n'); a = current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
changed = [(r,c,b[r][c],a[r][c]) for r in range(64) for c in range(64) if b[r][c]!=a[r][c]]
# summarize by row ranges
from collections import Counter
print("n changed:", len(changed))
# group
groups = Counter()
for r,c,o,n in changed:
    groups[(r//8, c//8, o, n)] += 1
for k,v in sorted(groups.items()):
    print(k, v)
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
